about.body: My professional experience is rooted in e-commerce product content and quality control. I work with product information, brand guidelines and accuracy at scale. Outside my day-to-day role, I enjoy turning ideas into practical digital experiences — combining curiosity, clear direction and AI-assisted tools to build and improve things.

experience.description: Supporting e-commerce product content operations, maintaining product information quality and following brand-specific content standards.
highlights: Write and maintain descriptions for 70+ products per day across multiple categories.
Prepare product details including materials, features, measurements, patterns and categories.
Review 100+ product IDs for accuracy, consistency and brand compliance.
Identify discrepancies and coordinate corrections while meeting daily quality and productivity targets.
